definitions.gloss: powdered milk; baby formula; infant formula
definitions.explanation: Dried milk in powder form. Most commonly refers to infant formula used as a substitute for or supplement to breast milk.

examples.japanese: {粉|こな}ミルク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{溶|と}かす→溶かす：08264_tokasu⟧。
examples.english: Dissolve the powdered milk in hot water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{粉|こな}ミルク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}ませた→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{母乳|ぼにゅう}→母乳：13237_bonyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{粉|こな}ミルク⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When there isn't enough breast milk, formula is sometimes used to supplement.

notes:
While {粉|こな}ミルク literally means 'powdered milk,' in everyday usage it almost always refers to infant formula. For powdered milk used in cooking or coffee, ⟦{脱脂粉乳|だっしふんにゅう}→脱脂粉乳：23667_dasshifunnyuu⟧ (skim milk powder) or スキム⟦ミルク→ミルク：00284_miruku⟧ is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粉|こな}ミルク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{溶|と}かす→溶かす：08264_tokasu⟧: to dissolve formula
- {粉|こな}ミルク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}ませる→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to feed formula
- {粉|こな}ミルク⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧: formula feeding
- {粉|こな}ミルク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to prepare formula
